digest.component_or_area: Model fallback configuration and capability resolution
propositions: Direct Anthropic fallback arms for frontier and standard classes are approved and live-proven but not yet enabled in rebar.toml due to the whole-chain capability intersection mechanism that conservatively downgrades primary capabilities to match fallback capabilities

The existing fallback mechanism intersects capabilities across all candidates before any attempt, causing native structured output on the primary to degrade to prompted output when a fallback candidate lacks native capability
Direct Anthropic Sonnet has been measured to support both native structured output and thinking via live non-interactive credential calls, resolving the asymmetry that previously kept it fail-closed
The trivial model class remains single-arm (Bedrock Haiku only) until direct Haiku native-output capability parity is measured
Mixed Bedrock/Anthropic chains must conservatively disable prompt caching due to differing provider-specific cache styles

Enabling the direct Anthropic fallback requires resolving a separate credential-shadowing defect where a valid key in ~/.zshrc is shadowed by an invalid key in the process environment used by agents and gates
